sources.quote: 入出力端子 コントローラ端子 ×２ メモリーカード差込口 ×２ ＡＶ ＭＵＬＴＩ ＯＵＴ（ＡＶマルチ出力）端子 ×１
新型「プレイステーション」 （ＳＣＰＨ－１００）新発売

notes: Sony's 2000-06-08 Japanese release (PDF, text extracted with macOS PDFKit; full-width digits kept). Axes labelled by Sony (幅/高さ/奥行き): width 193, height 38, depth 144. The release does not say whether projections are excluded.

ports = the release's 入出力端子 row (controller ×2, memory card ×2, AV MULTI OUT ×1) plus the DC IN 7.5V terminal from its 電源 row. The controller connector is Sony's own (Sony names it 'Controller port' / コントローラ端子 and no standard); it is filed as controller_proprietary. The DC inlet is 'DC IN 7.5V' with an AC adaptor in the box; Sony does not name the plug, so features.power_inlet stays null.
media: the release says it plays 「プレイステーション」規格ＣＤ－ＲＯＭ and 音楽ＣＤ but not how the disc loads; media stays uncovered.
external_ids: Wikidata Q8017670 ('smaller model of the PlayStation video game console'); Wikidata gives no IGDB platform id for it.
